title: Mackerel with roast peppers, plums and potatoes

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or a plain cupboard staple, with nothing factory-made such as jars, stock pots or mixes.

supermarket.reason: Potatoes, peppers, plums, mackerel fillets and balsamic are all everyday items at a mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray and a knife, and the technique is simple roasting.

works.reason: Halved small potatoes roasted for 35 to 37 minutes at 220°C will be tender, the fillets cook through in 10 to 12 minutes, and the quantities suit a lunch for four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is believable for halving the potatoes, slicing the peppers and onion, stripping the thyme and stoning the plums, and the 37 cook minutes match 25 plus up to 12.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the step's 'paprika' clearly means the listed smoked paprika, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm roast traybake with three peppers as a main component suits late September, and the peppers are central rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with no restaurant language.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, potatoes and plenty of vegetables make a balanced, appealing family lunch.
